preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (or gain ownership)

violation_target.exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call excludeFromFees() or excludeMultipleAccountsFromFees() to exclude attacker-controlled addresses from transaction fees. This allows the attacker to bypass the 1% additional fee when selling to automated market maker pairs, effectively enabling privileged trading. Alternatively, use setExcludeFromAll() to both exclude from fees and dividends in one call.

attempts.vulnerability_analysis: The FLOV contract has an owner-only function excludeFromFees() that allows privileged addresses to bypass transaction fees. The vulnerability is that the owner can exclude any address from fees, giving them unfair trading advantages. The oracle verification checks if the attacker address is in the _isExcludedFromFees mapping.
attempts.attack_strategy: Impersonate the contract owner and call excludeFromFees(attacker) to add the attacker address to the fee exclusion list.
attempts.step_by_step_plan: 1. Get the current owner address of the FLOV contract. 2. Use vm.prank() to impersonate the owner. 3. Call excludeFromFees(attacker, true) on the FLOV contract. 4. Verify that _isExcludedFromFees[attacker] == true.
